task: PIXEL-03 Phase 2: create isolated preview sessions before desktop rendering/apply integration

controls: Opaque session IDs and validated owner IDs
Owner-scoped reads and cancellation; wrong-owner and missing sessions share not-found response
Monotonic TTL with five-minute default and lazy/explicit expiry cleanup

No profile activation, profile-store writes, persistent preview state or desktop adapter calls
Volatile sessions are dropped on process restart; caller must bind authenticated identity and schedule cleanup
